summary: SMX (Security Matters) filed a Form 6-K attaching updated audited financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, reflecting the effects of two reverse stock splits (20:1 effective May 11, 2026, and 2.285:1 effective June 1, 2026). The filing is a routine update for a foreign private issuer; it does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned.
